description: D&D Beyond support: DDB PDF hints into the existing PdfCharacterExtractor, the DndBeyondUrlImportService (typed HttpClient + runaway guard + status mapping), the DndBeyondApiMapper and DndBeyondCompanionMapper, the new POST /api/characters/import/dndbeyond-url action, and the WireMock.Net-backed URL integration tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (abstraction, endpoint, IDndBeyondUrlImportService contract, DI). Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Read context.json and the design note sections 'Task 2' (DndBeyondApiMapper + DndBeyondUrlImportService), 'Task 3' (Companion), 'Task 8' (PDF hints), 'Ruleset detection', and the dndbeyond-url endpoint spec + error table.

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/DndBeyondSources.cs (if FEAT-002 did not): static readonly HashSet<int> Ruleset2024SourceIds = {672,673,674} with a comment that the list may be extended.

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/DndBeyondApiMapper.cs (Source=DndBeyondApi, Order=0). Detection (DDB API JSON saved as file): root has id, dateModified, classes, stats, race. Expose an internal MapFromRoot(JsonElement ddbRoot) so Companion can reuse it. Map name->Identity.Name; race.fullName->Identity.RaceOrAncestry (subRaceShortName->ExtraFields 'Subrace'); sum(classes[].level)->Classes[0].Level; classes[0].definition.name->Classes[0].ClassName; classes[0].subclassDefinition.name->Classes[0].Subclass; stats[0..5].value PLUS all bonus layers (bonusStats, overrideStats, racial/feat modifiers) summed->Abilities.* (if a summed score <1 or >30, keep it but add abilities.<name> to RequiresReviewPaths); hitPointInfo->Combat.MaxHitPoints=base+con, CurrentHitPoints=max-removedHitPoints, TemporaryHitPoints=temporaryHitPoints; armorClass.totalArmorClass (or overrideArmorClass)->Combat.ArmorClass. spells[]/inventory[]->ExtraFields. Forced 'dnd-5e-2014'. DetectRuleset(JsonElement): scan classes[].definition.sources[].sourceId; any in DndBeyondSources.Ruleset2024SourceIds -> '2024' else '2014'; ALWAYS set Ruleset and RulesetRequiresConfirmation=true. Confidence High. Numeric MappedFields values bare base-10 integer strings; omit unprovided paths.

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/DndBeyondCompanionMapper.cs (Source=DndBeyondCompanion, Order=0). Detection: root has 'character' with 'name'+'classes' AND (root has '_meta' OR root has 'ddbId'). Extract root.character as the working element and delegate to DndBeyondApiMapper.MapFromRoot. Same ruleset handling, forced 'dnd-5e-2014'.

Create src/backend/Aircane.Infrastructure/Characters/DndBeyondUrlImportService.cs implementing IDndBeyondUrlImportService. Parse id from a full dndbeyond.com/characters/{id} URL or a bare numeric id (first digit run in the /characters/ segment; max length 2048; reject when none -> DndBeyondImportException(InvalidUrl)). Typed HttpClient (BaseAddress https://character-service.dndbeyond.com/, Timeout 10s, default header User-Agent: Aircane-Tabletop/1.0). GET character/v5/character/{id}. Status mapping -> DndBeyondImportException(StatusKind): 403->Private403, 404->NotFound404, TaskCanceled/timeout->Timeout, other 5xx/network->Upstream. Add a process-wide runaway guard: static SemaphoreSlim(1,1) single-flight + a ~2s minimum interval between outbound calls, independent of tunnel state. NO response caching. NEVER log or store the URL string; log only the parsed numeric id at Debug and the HTTP status code.

MODIFY src/backend/Aircane.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs: register DndBeyondApiMapper and DndBeyondCompanionMapper as ICharacterSourceMapper, and services.AddHttpClient<IDndBeyondUrlImportService, DndBeyondUrlImportService>(c => { c.BaseAddress = new Uri("https://character-service.dndbeyond.com/"); c.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10); c.DefaultRequestHeaders.UserAgent... }).

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/DndBeyondPdfHints.cs: static IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string> FieldMap from DDB PDF form-field names to ApplyMapping paths: CharacterName->identity.name, ClassLevel->(special, post-split), Race->identity.raceOrAncestry, Background->identity.background, STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA->abilities.strength..charisma, HPMax->combat.maxHitPoints, HPCurrent->combat.hitPoints, AC->combat.armorClass, Speed->combat.speed, ProfBonus->combat.proficiencyBonus (18 skills -> notes, no ApplyMapping path). MODIFY src/backend/Aircane.Infrastructure/Characters/PdfCharacterExtractor.cs: in MapToCanonical, consult DndBeyondPdfHints.FieldMap as a priority override BEFORE the existing TryMapField (when a form-field name matches a key, use the mapped path). Post-parse: if a ClassLevel value matches ^(.+?)\s+(\d+)$ split into class name + level. Leave OCR/text fallback untouched.

MODIFY src/backend/Aircane.Api/Controllers/CharactersController.cs: inject IDndBeyondUrlImportService (now registered). Add action POST api/characters/import/dndbeyond-url with body record DndBeyondUrlImportRequest(string CharacterUrl, Guid? GameSystemDefinitionId, Guid? CampaignId) (CREATE src/backend/Aircane.Application/DTOs/Characters/DndBeyondUrlImportRequest.cs). Delegate to IDndBeyondUrlImportService.FetchAsync; run DndBeyondApiMapper + the shared persist/review helpers against the forced dnd-5e-2014 system; return the same SourceImportResponse. Map DndBeyondImportException: Private403->422 'This character is private. Make your character sheet public on D&D Beyond to import it.'; NotFound404->422 'Character not found. Check the URL and try again.'; Timeout->422 'D&D Beyond is not responding. Try again later.'; Upstream->422 'D&D Beyond import failed. Use the PDF export option instead.'; InvalidUrl->400 'Enter a valid D&D Beyond character URL or ID.'. Never store/log the URL.
Add WireMock.Net to tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/Aircane.IntegrationTests.csproj: <PackageReference Include="WireMock.Net" Version="1.6.11" /> (exact pin).

Add unit tests under tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Characters/Import/: DndBeyondApiMapperTests (stat summing across bonus layers; out-of-range summed score forced into RequiresReviewPaths; DetectRuleset by sourceId -> 2024/2014 + always RulesetRequiresConfirmation; HP/AC math), DndBeyondCompanionMapperTests (_meta/ddbId detection; character.-prefixed delegation to shared path), DndBeyondUrlParseTests (full URL, bare id, trailing path, non-numeric -> InvalidUrl), DndBeyondPdfHintsTests + extend PdfCharacterExtractorTests (hint override beats heuristic; ClassLevel 'Fighter 5' split). Add fixtures ddb-v5.json, ddb-companion.json (anonymised, name 'Test Character', no PII). Also add CanonicalCharacterPathsTests (bridge table 1:1: no duplicate schema id / path; every bridged path member of CanonicalCharacterPaths.Supported; experiencePoints/passivePerception/initiative/proficiencyBonus EXCLUDED from the 1:1 assertion) and MapperMappedFieldsTests (across all mappers: MappedFields contains only fixture-provided paths; a fixture missing AC/speed/abilities/HP yields no such key; every RequiresReviewPaths entry is a MappedFields key).

Add tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/DndBeyondUrlImportIntegrationTests.cs using a WireMock.Net local server; a derived AircaneWebApplicationFactory overrides the 'DndBeyond' typed client BaseAddress to the WireMock URL via ConfigureServices. Cases: 200 -> review payload; 403/404/timeout/5xx -> the exact messages + 422; invalid URL -> 400 'Enter a valid D&D Beyond character URL or ID.'. Capture logs via a test ILoggerProvider and assert the character URL string never appears.
Run the backend build and both backend test suites from the worktree; fix failures; commit locally on the branch (no push).
acceptance_criteria: dotnet test tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Aircane.UnitTests.csproj passes, including DndBeyondApiMapperTests, DndBeyondCompanionMapperTests, DndBeyondUrlParseTests, DndBeyondPdfHintsTests, CanonicalCharacterPathsTests, MapperMappedFieldsTests, and the extended PdfCharacterExtractorTests.

dotnet test tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/Aircane.IntegrationTests.csproj passes, including DndBeyondUrlImportIntegrationTests (200/403/404/timeout/5xx/invalid-URL with exact messages, and the no-URL-in-logs assertion).
WireMock.Net is pinned to exactly 1.6.11 in the IntegrationTests csproj.
The DDB character URL never appears in any log output.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED (build 0 errors; UnitTests 2125 pass, IntegrationTests 96 pass; FEAT-001/002 regression green).

NEW TYPES / NAMESPACES:
- Aircane.Application.Characters.Import.DndBeyondSources (static): HashSet<int> Ruleset2024SourceIds = {672,673,674}.
- Aircane.Application.Characters.Import.DndBeyondApiMapper : ICharacterSourceMapper (Source=DndBeyondApi, Order=0). Detection CanMap: root object with id+dateModified+classes+stats+race. Exposes internal static MapFromRoot(JsonElement), CanMapRoot(JsonElement), DetectRuleset(JsonElement) (DetectRuleset is reached by DndBeyondApiMapperTests via InternalsVisibleTo). Mapping: name->identity.name; race.fullName->identity.raceOrAncestry (race.subRaceShortName->ExtraFields 'Subrace'); sum(classes[].level)->Classes[0].Level; classes[0].definition.name->ClassName; classes[0].subclassDefinition.name->Subclass (also ExtraFields 'Subclass'). ABILITIES: base stats[] indexed by stat id 1=STR..6=CHA, PLUS bonusStats[] PLUS modifier bonuses (modifiers.<category>[] where type=='bonus' and subType endswith '-score', e.g. 'strength-score'); an overrideStats[] value REPLACES base+bonus. A summed score <1 or >30 is kept and its abilities.<name> path added to RequiresReviewPaths. HP: hitPointInfo.baseHitPoints + (CON modifier * total level)->MaxHitPoints; current=max-removedHitPoints; TemporaryHitPoints=temporaryHitPoints (hitPointInfo may be nested OR fields may sit on root; both handled). AC: armorClass.totalArmorClass, overridden by root.overrideArmorClass when present. spells{}/[] and inventory[] summarized into ExtraFields. Forced GameSystemIdentifier='dnd-5e-2014'; Ruleset from DetectRuleset (scan classes[].definition.sources[].sourceId; any in Ruleset2024SourceIds->'2024' else '2014'); ALWAYS RulesetRequiresConfirmation=true; Confidence High. Numeric MappedFields are bare base-10 strings; unprovided paths omitted.
- Aircane.Application.Characters.Import.DndBeyondCompanionMapper : ICharacterSourceMapper (Source=DndBeyondCompanion, Order=0). Detection: root.character has name+classes AND (root has _meta OR root has ddbId). Map unwraps root.character and delegates to DndBeyondApiMapper.MapFromRoot (same ruleset handling, forced dnd-5e-2014).
- Aircane.Application.Characters.Import.DndBeyondPdfHints (static): IReadOnlyDictionary<string,string> FieldMap (OrdinalIgnoreCase) DDB PDF form-field name -> ApplyMapping path (CharacterName/Race/Background/STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA/HPMax/HPCurrent/AC/Speed/ProfBonus). const ClassLevelFieldName='ClassLevel' is NOT in FieldMap (handled by a post-split step). 18 skills have no path (fall through to notes/unmapped).
- Aircane.Infrastructure.Characters.DndBeyondUrlImportService : IDndBeyondUrlImportService. internal static ParseCharacterId(string) (reached by DndBeyondUrlParseTests via InternalsVisibleTo): accepts bare numeric id OR full URL, takes first digit run after '/characters/', max length 2048, rejects (DndBeyondImportException InvalidUrl) when none/non-digit/overlong/<=0. Typed HttpClient; GET character/v5/character/{id}. Status map: 403->Private403, 404->NotFound404, other !success->Upstream; HttpClient timeout (OperationCanceledException with ct NOT cancelled)->Timeout; HttpRequestException->Upstream. PROCESS-WIDE RUNAWAY GUARD: static SemaphoreSlim(1,1) single-flight + static _lastCallUtc with a 2s MinimumInterval between outbound calls (independent of tunnel state). NO caching. URL is NEVER logged/stored; only the parsed numeric id (Debug) + HTTP status code (Debug) are logged.
- Aircane.Application.DTOs.Characters.DndBeyondUrlImportRequest(string CharacterUrl, Guid? GameSystemDefinitionId=null, Guid? CampaignId=null).

MODIFIED:
- DI (Aircane.Infrastructure.DependencyInjection): added AddScoped<ICharacterSourceMapper, DndBeyondApiMapper>() and DndBeyondCompanionMapper (after PathbuilderTwoMapper, before Foundry); added services.AddHttpClient<IDndBeyondUrlImportService, DndBeyondUrlImportService>(BaseAddress https://character-service.dndbeyond.com/, Timeout 10s, UserAgent 'Aircane-Tabletop/1.0').
- PdfCharacterExtractor.MapToCanonical: NEW private TryMapByDndBeyondHint is consulted BEFORE TryMapField for every extracted field. When a field name matches DndBeyondPdfHints.FieldMap it maps via the hinted canonical path (new private ApplyCanonicalPath switches on CanonicalCharacterPaths consts and reuses existing ParseAbilityScore/ParseIntField). ClassLevel field: multiclass values containing '/' delegate to existing MapClassLevel; otherwise regex ^(.+?)\s+(\d+)$ splits class name + level. OCR/text fallback untouched. (Added usings System.Text.RegularExpressions + Aircane.Application.Characters.Import.)
- CharactersController: now injects IDndBeyondUrlImportService (registered this FEAT). NEW action POST api/characters/import/dndbeyond-url (inherits [Authorize(DmOrHost)]), body DndBeyondUrlImportRequest: empty url->400 'Enter a valid D&D Beyond character URL or ID.'; FetchAsync; parse JSON (unparseable upstream body->422 'D&D Beyond import failed. Use the PDF export option instead.'); resolve DndBeyondApi mapper + forced dnd-5e-2014 via ResolveBuiltInSystemAsync; mapper.Map; PersistDraftFromCanonicalAsync (reused from FEAT-001; originalFileName null); BuildSourceReview (reused). NEW private MapDndBeyondFailure maps DndBeyondImportException: Private403->422 'This character is private. Make your character sheet public on D&D Beyond to import it.'; NotFound404->422 'Character not found. Check the URL and try again.'; Timeout->422 'D&D Beyond is not responding. Try again later.'; Upstream->422 'D&D Beyond import failed. Use the PDF export option instead.'; InvalidUrl->400 'Enter a valid D&D Beyond character URL or ID.'. SourceImportResponse.DetectedSource is 'DndBeyondApi' (string, consistent with FEAT-001 no-JsonStringEnumConverter note).
- Aircane.Application.csproj + Aircane.Infrastructure.csproj: added <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Aircane.UnitTests" /> so DetectRuleset / ParseCharacterId are unit-testable.
- Aircane.IntegrationTests.csproj: added <PackageReference Include="WireMock.Net" Version="1.6.11" /> (exact pin).

TESTS: UnitTests tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Characters/Import/{DndBeyondApiMapperTests, DndBeyondCompanionMapperTests, DndBeyondUrlParseTests, DndBeyondPdfHintsTests, CanonicalCharacterPathsTests, MapperMappedFieldsTests}.cs; extended Characters/PdfCharacterExtractorTests.cs (3 DDB-hint tests). Fixtures Characters/Import/Fixtures/{ddb-v5.json, ddb-companion.json} (anonymised, name 'Test Character', no PII; ddb-v5 sourceId 1->2014, companion sourceId 672->2024). Integration tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/DndBeyondUrlImportIntegrationTests.cs: WireMockServer + derived DndBeyondWebApplicationFactory re-registers the typed client at the WireMock url (timeout shortened to 2s for the timeout case); seeds systems via GameSystemDefinitionSeeder; cases 200/403/404/5xx/timeout/invalid-URL assert exact messages+status; a CapturingLoggerProvider (added via ConfigureServices) asserts neither the URL nor 'dndbeyond.com/characters' appears in any log.

FOR LATER FEATS (FEAT-004 = frontend): the DDB URL endpoint returns the same SourceImportResponse envelope. detectedSource is a STRING. The two-call Roll20/Generic handshake and ForcedIdentifier map are unchanged from FEAT-001. The frontend (ImportCharacterModal tabs, ImportReviewPanel, api/store calls, previewCharacterForm) is NOT implemented.
